findings.evidence: Lines 180–181 only compose `Matrix.kroneckerTMulAlgEquiv` with `Matrix.reindexAlgEquiv`. Mathlib’s declaration at `Mathlib/RingTheory/MatrixAlgebra.lean:240` assumes `CommSemiring`, `Semiring`, algebra/scalar-tower, `Fintype`, and `DecidableEq`; it has no simplicity, centrality, finite-dimensionality, or nonemptiness assumption.
findings.fix: State the reindexed `Fin` equivalence first for arbitrary `K`-algebras (with the semiring/algebra assumptions of `Matrix.kroneckerTMulAlgEquiv`) and arbitrary `m n`; then derive the bundled positive-size `CSA` wrapper used by Brauer equivalence.
findings.issue: `CSA.tensorProductMatrixAlgEquiv` bundles both coefficient algebras as `CSA` and requires `NeZero m`/`NeZero n`, although the underlying matrix equivalence needs neither central simplicity nor positive dimensions.

summary: The matrix-absorption API is unnecessarily restricted to central simple algebras and positive matrix sizes.
